topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the notebook tucked away in the back of the closet, its pages filled with a story that seemed strangely familiar. Each character, every scene, mirrored our life, our moments—both the light and the shadows. The coffee stains on the pages, the way the handwriting wavered, told the story of late nights and early mornings, of stories crafted with more than just ink. I flipped through quickly, then slowly, absorbing the depths of emotions laid bare. Outside, the world was calm; inside, a thousand questions swirled, each one vying for attention, each one demanding answers I wasn’t sure I wanted to hear.
